reasoning: The new instruction explicitly authorizes only a change of rendering style to watercolour storybook. All other fields—intent (endpoint preservation and dissolve), seconds (8), aspect (16:9), shots, mode (fl2va), creativity, frame anchors asset-1/asset-2 with roles and timings, and both supplied assets with their locators, hashes, descriptions and roles—are expressly preserved and remain unchanged. No observation or Asset.Description is rewritten; the target appearance change is expressed solely in the style field.
